scope: one short unchanged acknowledged two-observation maintenance trace, baseline2 fresh calls versus opt-in gate1; no full project/long-context/cash claim

implementation.procedure: Review gate admission and trusted callback path, actual same-input native trace.
implementation.acceptance: Only acknowledged equivalent event skips, no scheduling or verification bypass.

reference_boundary.procedure: Run10 fixed boundaries and independent observer/callback trace.

data_integrity.procedure: Check frozen exact source/settings/schema/prompt and3 original native RPC streams.
data_integrity.acceptance: Three fresh no-tool turns, all provider input+output included; no retries/old data.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute integer bills and exact missing-evidence decision.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: No publish from pending evidence/GPU idle; both traces same safe outcome, candidate total strictly lower.

measurement_validity.procedure: Compare model/high/tools/policy and all observable non-task instruction plaintext.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Same short task and controls, baseline2 calls/candidate1, per-call<=25000/spend<=75000.

reproducibility.procedure: Fixed different-owner host native readback and10 CPU tests, no new inference.
reproducibility.acceptance: Independent verify_experiment_result accepted with explicit one-trace scope.
